textRuns.value: Patients are NOT linked across the identifiable / pseudonymised boundary, so patient-journey views are aggregate, not per-patient. Rising-risk is a proxy segment (CMS Q3-Q4 plus markers), not a longitudinal trajectory. RTT and DM01 are aggregate NHS returns with no LSOA, so they carry no deprivation cut. Peer-ICS benchmarking and wider-determinant overlays await external data loads.
